profile.name: Sakib Bin Faruque Rusho
profile.headline: Android & AI engineer building production apps with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
profile.tagline: I build reliable, well-architected mobile apps for AI-assisted healthcare, and I care about the machine learning that runs behind them.
about: I'm a software engineer at MyMedicalHub International, where I build native Android apps for AI-assisted healthcare, rehabilitation and athletic assessment. My work covers movement analysis, posture tracking, frame-level pose analysis and Android Health Connect integration.

Before moving to native Android I shipped Flutter apps with Firebase and Clean Architecture. I studied Computer Science & Engineering at the University of Rajshahi, where my thesis improved object detection in aerial imagery by combining attention and contrast enhancement in RetinaNet.
I'm most interested in the space where mobile engineering meets machine learning: taking models out of notebooks and into apps people rely on.
profile.photoAlt: Portrait of Sakib Bin Faruque Rusho
profile.availabilityText: Open to Android and AI/ML engineering roles

highlights: Develop and maintain production Android apps in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for AI-assisted healthcare, rehabilitation and athletic assessment.
Integrated Android Health Connect to read health and activity data from wearable devices into the apps' assessment and progress features.
Implement computer vision video processing with frame-level pose analysis and automatic presence detection to control session triggers.
Build musculoskeletal assessment, movement analysis, posture tracking and exercise-guidance features with AI-assisted feedback.
Work with backend, QA and product teams to test, debug and ship features, using CI/CD and Agile routines.
Developed production Flutter apps integrated with Firebase, using Clean Architecture with Cubit/Bloc.

projects.title: StudyBuddy AI
projects.description: An Android app that turns a photo of a textbook question into a short, exam-style answer. A vision LLM reads Bangla, math and diagrams with an on-device OCR fallback, plus automatic model fallback, follow-up answers, saved answers and Keystore-encrypted API keys.

projects.title: Limiter
projects.description: A digital wellbeing app that tracks usage, enforces daily limits and blocks restricted apps through real-time foreground-app monitoring, with a full-screen lockout countdown when a limit is reached.

projects.title: Smart Queue
projects.description: A full-stack system with a REST API and React dashboard for booking, live queue status and call-next, complete and cancel workflows.

projects.title: E-commerce Platform
projects.description: A shopping app with real-time updates and Stripe payments, plus a separate admin panel for managing products and orders.

projects.title: VoiceBridge
projects.description: An educational app with gamified learning, emotion recognition and progress tracking, built during Learnathon 3.0.

projects.title: Voyage Visage
projects.description: A travel blogging app where people can document and share trips, with image uploads, real-time updates and profile management.

projects.title: Face Verification
projects.description: Trained and evaluated Siamese neural networks using BCE, Contrastive and Triplet Loss on the WIDER FACE and Anime datasets.

projects.title: GAN Variants for Face Generation
projects.description: Implemented DCGAN, Conditional GAN and CycleGAN for synthetic face generation, attribute transfer and image-to-image translation.

projects.title: Crowd Counting & Density Segmentation
projects.description: Trained U-Net and MCNN architectures on ShanghaiTech Part A for crowd density estimation, evaluated with MAE and RMSE.

projects.title: Knowledge Distillation & Transfer Learning
projects.description: Implemented soft-label batch-wise distillation between ResNet50, VGG16 and compact student CNNs to speed up edge inference with minimal accuracy loss.

research.title: Integrating CBAM and CLAHE in RetinaNet for Enhanced Remote Sensing Object Detection
research.description: A RetinaNet-based framework that combines attention mechanisms and contrast enhancement to improve object detection in aerial imagery.
